input.rationale: discharge_date is only recorded for inpatient (IPD) stays; outpatient and emergency visits end on the day they start, which is the OHDSI convention when no end date is known.

final_text: etlDefaultedValue flagged visit_end_date: it was NULL for 2870 of 3228 visits, and the build gave those visits their start date. The counts show why: clinic_visits.discharge_date is empty for every OPD and EMERG visit and for no IPD visit (only inpatient stays have a discharge date). Ending a visit without a discharge date on its start date is the OMOP convention, so the loaded dates were right, but the spec should say so rather than rely on the fallback: I changed visit_end_date to COALESCE(v.discharge_date::date, v.visit_date::date). Single-day visits now end on their start date by design, and inpatient stays keep their discharge date.
